PROJECTS

IQ4BUS - Digital Foundation Layer

Daimler Truck Innovation Center India | RMZ NXT, Whitefield

 Developed a Microservices-based architecture where individual services manage specific divisions like Defect Recording, Master Configuration (PDA), and D-Analysis, etc.

 Engineered the Treasure File Scheduler backend service to automate the generation of system reports (PDFs) and archive them into environment-specific shared folders.

 Built the PDA (Master-Config) module as the single source of truth for operator data, environment settings, and KPI-related analytics.

 Created intuitive frontend interfaces in React.js to facilitate seamless data exchange with backend services for real-time defect tracking and multi-dimensional analysis.

  Technologies Used: React.js, Java Spring Boot, Hibernate, Microservices, REST APIs, PostgreSQL Server, Azure, Kubernetes.

IQ4BUS | T-Rex

Daimler Truck Innovation Center India | RMZ NXT, Whitefield

 Developed a unified, high-traffic platform serving as a central hub for product owners, plant workers, directors, and customers to track and interact with the vehicle manufacturing lifecycle.

 Integrated Azure IAM to manage complex, role-based access control, ensuring secure and tailored data visibility for a diverse user base spanning different organizational levels.

 Engineered the backend to support large-scale user traffic by implementing Azure Cache for Redis for high-speed data retrieval and Azure Event Hubs for real-time event streaming.

 Collaborated with data analytics teams to integrate KPI-driven dashboards, providing stakeholders with interactive insights into production efficiency and manufacturing milestones.

 Technologies Used: React.js, Java Spring Boot, Hibernate, PostgreSQL Server, Azure IAM, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Event

Hubs, Kubernetes, Microservices, REST APIs, Data Analytics.

UDB Application Development

Unisys | RGA Tech Park, Carmelaram

 UDB, Unisys Digital Banking, is a comprehensive digital banking product encompassing web and mobile platforms.

 Spearheaded full-stack development for Unisys Digital Banking (UDB), a comprehensive digital banking solution spanning web and mobile platforms.

 Engineered intuitive and engaging user interfaces using React.js and Figma, ensuring an optimal user experience.

 Architected and implemented a scalable backend infrastructure with Java Spring Boot and AWS, enabling efficient data storage, seamless data parsing through REST APIs, and secure user authentication via Spring Security & AWS Cognito.

 Designed and managed databases using Microsoft SQL and MongoDB, optimized cache management with Redis, and streamlined log aggregation through Apache Kafka pipelines.

 Technologies Used: React.js, Java Spring Boot, Microservices, Redis, Kafka, Ms-SQL, MongoDB, Pay. Gateway, AWS, Jenkins,

SonarQube, AI.

ADQI Portal Development

TCS | Adibatla, Hyderabad

 Developed the ADQI web portal, a centralized data exhibit point providing Lloyds Banking Group employees and management with user-friendly access to customer and transaction information.

 Engineered the backend (TODS) to handle a massive volume of customer account transactions and associated banking product data, ensuring seamless operations and management.

 Implemented dynamic data storage for new REST-API additions and enabled offline data retrieval in Excel format.

 Collaborated with the development team and product manager to model the program architecture, taking ownership of front- end development using ReactJS.

 Implemented robust data security, password management, and RESTful APIs with LDAP, Spring Security, Spring Boot, and Microservices.

 Designed and managed databases using PostgreSQL.

 Technologies Used: React.js, CSS, Java Spring Boot, Spring Security, Microservices, Hibernate, JDBC, PostgreSQL, Node.js, LDAP.

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
PROJECTS
IQ4BUS - Digital Foundation Layer
Daimler Truck Innovation Center India | RMZ NXT, Whitefield
 Developed a Microservices-based architecture where individual services manage specific divisions like Defect Recording, Master Configuration (PDA), and D-Analysis, etc.
 Engineered the Treasure File Scheduler backend service to automate the generation of system reports (PDFs) and archive them into environment-specific shared folders.
 Built the PDA (Master-Config) module as the single source of truth for operator data, environment settings, and KPI-related analytics.
 Created intuitive frontend interfaces in React.js to facilitate seamless data exchange with backend services for real-time defect tracking and multi-dimensional analysis.
  Technologies Used: React.js, Java Spring Boot, Hibernate, Microservices, REST APIs, PostgreSQL Server, Azure, Kubernetes.
IQ4BUS | T-Rex
Daimler Truck Innovation Center India | RMZ NXT, Whitefield
 Developed a unified, high-traffic platform serving as a central hub for product owners, plant workers, directors, and customers to track and interact with the vehicle manufacturing lifecycle.
 Integrated Azure IAM to manage complex, role-based access control, ensuring secure and tailored data visibility for a diverse user base spanning different organizational levels.
 Engineered the backend to support large-scale user traffic by implementing Azure Cache for Redis for high-speed data retrieval and Azure Event Hubs for real-time event streaming.
 Collaborated with data analytics teams to integrate KPI-driven dashboards, providing stakeholders with interactive insights into production efficiency and manufacturing milestones.
 Technologies Used: React.js, Java Spring Boot, Hibernate, PostgreSQL Server, Azure IAM, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Event
Hubs, Kubernetes, Microservices, REST APIs, Data Analytics.
UDB Application Development
Unisys | RGA Tech Park, Carmelaram
 UDB, Unisys Digital Banking, is a comprehensive digital banking product encompassing web and mobile platforms.
 Spearheaded full-stack development for Unisys Digital Banking (UDB), a comprehensive digital banking solution spanning web and mobile platforms.
 Engineered intuitive and engaging user interfaces using React.js and Figma, ensuring an optimal user experience.
 Architected and implemented a scalable backend infrastructure with Java Spring Boot and AWS, enabling efficient data storage, seamless data parsing through REST APIs, and secure user authentication via Spring Security & AWS Cognito.
 Designed and managed databases using Microsoft SQL and MongoDB, optimized cache management with Redis, and streamlined log aggregation through Apache Kafka pipelines.
 Technologies Used: React.js, Java Spring Boot, Microservices, Redis, Kafka, Ms-SQL, MongoDB, Pay. Gateway, AWS, Jenkins,
SonarQube, AI.
ADQI Portal Development
TCS | Adibatla, Hyderabad
 Developed the ADQI web portal, a centralized data exhibit point providing Lloyds Banking Group employees and management with user-friendly access to customer and transaction information.
 Engineered the backend (TODS) to handle a massive volume of customer account transactions and associated banking product data, ensuring seamless operations and management.
 Implemented dynamic data storage for new REST-API additions and enabled offline data retrieval in Excel format.
 Collaborated with the development team and product manager to model the program architecture, taking ownership of front- end development using ReactJS.
 Implemented robust data security, password management, and RESTful APIs with LDAP, Spring Security, Spring Boot, and Microservices.
 Designed and managed databases using PostgreSQL.
 Technologies Used: React.js, CSS, Java Spring Boot, Spring Security, Microservices, Hibernate, JDBC, PostgreSQL, Node.js, LDAP.
